It was written and produced by Jackson , in collaboration with James `` Jimmy Jam '' Harris III and Terrence `` Terry '' Lewis . Jackson developed the song 's concept in response to various tragedies in the media , deciding to pursue a socially conscious theme by using a political standpoint within upbeat dance music . In the United States , it peaked at number two on the Billboard Hot 100 and topped the Hot R&B / Hip-Hop Songs and Dance Club Songs singles charts . `` Escapade '' is a song by American R&B / pop entertainer Janet Jackson , released as the third single from her fourth studio album Rhythm Nation 1814 . The song was released following Jackson 's `` Rhythm Nation '' single and became the third of the historic seven top five singles released from the Rhythm Nation 1814 album . The song 's music video takes place at an exotic carnival setting , also featuring Jackson 's trademark intense choreography .
